overall: The AG found the School Committee's notice of "Town Meeting Update" lacked the specificity required by G.L. c. 30A, § 20(b), resolved the complaint with guidance, and declined to order rescission of the action taken.

allegations.summary: Notice listed only 'Town Meeting Update' though the Committee knew the warrant articles it would discuss and vote on at its Oct. 18, 2010 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: "Town Meeting Update" does not provide sufficient specificity when the chair of the Committee is aware of the specific items to be discussed and voted upon.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance: the Committee is required to comply with the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25, and to provide sufficient detail in meeting notices so the public knows with specificity what will be discussed (guidance only; no rescission ordered).
remedy_passage: In the future, the Committee is required to comply with the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25, and is advised to provide sufficient detail in meeting notices so that members of the public know with specificity what issues will be discussed by the Committee.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
